level_1: Uses electronic health records (EHRs) to obtain relevant clinical information; contacts referring physician when reason for exam is unclear

level_3: With assistance, delineates the clinical question, obtains appropriate clinical information, uses evidence-based imaging guidelines, and recommends next steps for complex consultations
level_4: Manages consultations independently, taking into consideration cost effectiveness and risk- benefit analysis
level_5: Provides comprehensive consultations at the expert level

level_1: Performs procedures with direct supervision

level_1: With supervision, selects appropriate protocol and contrast agent/dose for commonly performed pediatric imaging exams
With supervision, applies techniques to optimize image quality

level_4: Describes basic techniques to optimize image quality

level_1: Makes primary observations and formulates differential diagnoses, including consideration of normal pediatric imaging anatomy

level_5: Applies knowledge of anatomy to make imaging diagnoses of less common pediatric conditions
